prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a big blue-skinned ogre sorcerer in a long hooded patchwork robe of dark purple and brown patches with the hood down, a single short horn on its forehead, a wild white mane of hair, two small tusks, gold earrings, holding one tall gnarled wooden staff topped with a pale blue ice orb in the hand on the right side of the image; the robe hem above its bare blue feet; centred in its own cell, and in every cell the orb stays well below the top of the grey box. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its blue ogre face with the single horn, tusks and small eyes is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, stepping forward and leaning toward the heroes, the staff held upright in front of his chest in the same hand as in the idle cell, the ice orb raised beside his head and glowing brighter, the free hand thrust forward with the palm open; the whole staff and orb stay well inside the middle cell (the staff stays vertical, not pointed at the cell edge), facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the free hand thrown up, the staff held upright close to the body in the same hand as in the idle cell, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso and thrust the staff with the elbows bent, so every reaching part stays well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts and clothing named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak, scarf or extra cloth, and no spell effects, smear, motion arc or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a club, a cleaver, armour, two horns, a helmet, tan skin, grey skin, an ice beam, snowflakes.
